765:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「We were caught in a $$時空震動$$ in the $$ジオフロント$$...」

765:t_000:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain! The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ is here too!」

765:t_000:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「So the $$ダナン$$ was transported from $$相模湾$$ too...」

765:t_000:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I confirm all $c units have been recovered. However, EVA Unit-01's whereabouts are unknown.」

765:t_000:6.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Did $$シンジ$$ cause that $$時空震動$$...?」

765:t_000:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「He... or rather, EVA Unit-01 was probably the cause.」

765:t_000:8.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain, we have determined our current position.」

765:t_000:9.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Judging from our observations of the entire sky, we haven't crossed between parallel worlds. We seem to have moved only through physical space.」

765:t_000:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So this is the world we were in before.」

765:t_000:11.en:
$$モニカ$$
「But the red seas have disappeared from Earth.」

765:t_000:14.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So part of the world was transported by that $$時空震動$$...」

765:t_000:15.en:
$$キャシー$$
「We had data showing that the world $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ originally came from had a low dimensional fusion value with this world.」

765:t_000:16.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So that $$時空震動$$ separated it from our world...」

765:t_000:17.en:
$$ラム$$
「We have established communications with the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

765:t_000:18.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, Captain $$オットー$$, I'm very glad you're safe.」

765:t_000:19.en:
$$オットー$$
「Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, is everything all right on your end?」

765:t_000:20.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s spaceflight mode has no major problems either.」

765:t_000:21.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「We've checked our position. We appear to be halfway between our $$蒼の地球$$ and the other Earth... what is called $$翠の地球$$.」

765:t_000:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$翠の地球$$... I hear $$サイデリアル$$ conquered that Earth before ours...」

765:t_000:23.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...I'd like to discuss our next course of action. Captain $$オットー$$ and Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, please come aboard.」

765:t_000:25.en:
$$テッサ$$
(So this was what $$カナメ$$'s unease was about...)

765:t_000:26.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain...! We have detected a unit approaching this sector!」

765:t_000:27.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All hands, prepare to intercept! It may be $$サイデリアル$$!」

765:t_001:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「An $$アスクレプス$$...! Is it 《$$クロノ$$》's 《$$アドヴェント#pilot$$》!?」

765:t_001:2.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「But wasn't he killed in the final battle with 《$$ジェミニス$$》...?」

765:t_001:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「Yes... And the machine's coloring is different too.」

765:t_001:4.en:
$$ブルー$$
「This is Code: $$ブルー$$ of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists. $c, please respond.」

765:t_001:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「You're one of $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s subordinates...」

765:t_001:6.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Yes. I have met you several times before.」

765:t_001:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Your machine seems different from the one you had then.」

765:t_001:8.en:
$$ブルー$$
「The mass-produced $$アスクレプス$$ normally has this coloring, but...」

765:t_001:9.en:
$$ブルー$$
「When I met you, I had disguised it in our captain's colors for camouflage.」

765:t_001:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Why exactly are you here?」

765:t_001:11.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I request permission to land so that I can explain.」

765:t_001:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...Very well. Come to the $$マクロス・クォーター$$.」
